compress_waveform_to_bytes: compress a waveform tensor to compressed bytes using an EncodecModel with optional language model entropy coding
decompress_bytes_to_waveform: decompress encoded bytes back into a waveform tensor and sample rate using the Encodec model
compress_to_file_object: compress a waveform tensor and write the compressed output directly to a file object using an EncodecModel
decompress_from_file_object: decompress audio from a file object and return the waveform tensor and sample rate
test_compress_decompress_roundtrip: test the compress and decompress functions by encoding and decoding test WAV files with both models
